lightIdle: Patohia tētahi wāhitau paetukutuku. Ka tirotirohia tō mātou rārangi mōrearea ake, te hanganga, ngā tairitenga waitohu, te DNS me te urupare ora. I te Tū: wehe, whakamana i tētahi hongere ōkawa kua whakawhirinakitia kē, kātahi ka pūrongo ina hiahia.
lightLimited: Ko te Mārama te tikanga kāore he whakatūpato kaha i ngā tirotiro — ehara i te oati kei te haumaru te pae.
privacyNote: Taunoa: kāore he mea e puritia. Ka āwhina ngā tātaritanga i ngā raru hangarau anake — kāore rawa te wāhitau, kāore rawa mō te tuku tūmatanui.
claim: E kī ana tēnei pae ko…
privacy: Ka noho tēnei tirotiro ki tēnei rorohiko. Kāore e puritia te hītori tirotiro.
invalid: Tāuruhia he wāhitau HTTP, HTTPS rānei e tika ana.
limits: Ngā mea kāore e mōhiotia e tēnei tirotiro
ignoreRiskBody: Ka taea te tuku kupuhipa, taipitopito utu, raraunga whaiaro rānei ki te hunga e whakahaere ana i tēnei wāhitau. Katia te ripa i mua i te patopato, i te utu rānei.
nextStepsTitle: He aha te mahi i muri — hikoi mā hikoi
nextStepLeave: Wehe ināianei i tēnei whārangi — kaua e haere tonu i te wāhitau i tirohia.
nextStepNoCredentials: Kaua e tāuru kupuhipa, nama kāri, waehere SMS/īmēra, raraunga whaiaro rānei ki tēnei pae.
nextStepVerifyOfficial: Whakamana motuhake: whakatuwheratia te rohe ōkawa, taupānga rānei o te rōpū kua whakawhirinakitia kē (tohuwāhi, kāri pēke, toa taupānga mōhiotia). Kaua e whakamahi waea, īmēra rānei e whakaaturia ana i te whārangi whakapātaritari.
nextStepReport: Kōwhiringa: tiakina i raro he hukihuki pūrongo paetata kia arotake te kaiwhakahaere i te kaihautū mō te rārangi mōrearea kua whakaritea.
nextStepBlock: Kōwhiringa: āraia te kaihautū i te toronga, taupānga papamahi rānei a buusdo kia uaua ake te whakatuwhera hē.
nextStepLooksReal: He ātaahua ngā whārangi tinihanga, ā, ka whakamahi HTTPS. Ehara te kounga tirohanga i te tohu kei te tika te pae.
honestLimitsTitle: Ngā tepenga pono o tēnei taputapu
honestLimitNoWipe: Kāore e taea e buusdo te muku mōhiohio whaiaro kua kohia kē e tētahi pae. Hurihia ngā kupuhipa i te pae ōkawa tūturu mēnā i tāuruhia tētahi mea, ā, mātakihia ngā whakamōhiotanga pēke/īmēra.
honestLimitNoCrowd: Ka ahu mai ngā hua i te rārangi kua whakaritea me ngā tohu wāhitau a buusdo — ehara i te tatau pōti tūmatanui mō te tokomaha i tohu i te pae.
honestLimitNoAv: Ehara tēnei i te hua aukati huaketo. Ka mutu te tāuru raraunga i konei mā te kati i te ripa; kāore e karapa, e horoi rānei i tō pūrere.
feedbackDraftsAfterReport: I muri i te hukihuki pūrongo Tū: tohua te rārangi i raro, kaweake batches/*.json, kātahi ka whakahaere te kaiwhakahaere i npm run threat:apply. Kāore he mea e tukuna mai i tēnei pūtirotiro.
